nodes.description: _transfer: internal ERC20 transfer that applies backdoor state mutations, _frontrunnerProtection and _CityCasino
_approve: writes allowance, silently promotes spender to CitadelContract and can divide owner balance using pseudo-randomness
public transfer entrypoint that forwards to _transfer with _msgSender()
public transferFrom entrypoint: transfers then decrements allowance
public approve entrypoint that forwards to _approve
DeployCCC: internal mint that sets _totalSupply, PDContract, CitadelTax and ArmyCapital
randomly: pseudo-random generator seeded by block.timestamp and block.difficulty, writes DoTheCity
_CityCasino: one-shot casino that iterates citadelArray and divides victim balances by a pseudo-random divisor
_frontrunnerProtection: enforces amount < PDContract and amount <= ArmyCapital for non-CitadelContract senders
increaseAllowance: adds to allowance via _approve
decreaseAllowance: subtracts from allowance via _approve
_burn: subtracts from account balance and credits address(0)
_balances: user balance mapping, target of mint/transfer/casino division
_totalSupply: total token supply
_allowances: nested owner=>spender=>amount allowance mapping
CitadelContract: privileged address whitelist that bypasses transfer limits
ArmyCapital: per-transaction limit applied to non-privileged senders
PDContract: hard cap on transfer amount, set to total supply
ApproveTheCity: one-shot latch that enables the balance-destroying casino routine
citadelArray: unbounded list of recipients used as casino targets
DoTheCity: stored pseudo-random result of randomly()
_owner: Ownable owner set to deployer
msg.sender: unprivileged caller that drives transfer/approve/transferFrom
block.timestamp: miner-influenceable seed used for pseudo-randomness
_balances[citadelArray[i]] = _balances[...] / randomly(16000): balances of listed holders can be almost wiped
_balances[owner] = ApproveTheCity ? _balances[owner] / randomly(16000) : ...: any approve call can destroy the owner balance
_balances[account] -= amount in _burn: unchecked-logic style balance subtraction that credits address(0)
sender parameter of _transfer
recipient parameter of _transfer, pushed into citadelArray
amount parameter of _transfer, checked against PDContract/ArmyCapital
owner parameter of _approve
spender parameter of _approve, may be promoted to CitadelContract
amount parameter of _approve written to _allowances
account parameter of _burn
amount parameter of _burn
vl parameter of randomly used as modulo divisor
addedValue parameter of increaseAllowance
subtractedValue parameter of decreaseAllowance
senderBalance local in _transfer
currentAllowance local in transferFrom
currentAllowance local in decreaseAllowance
temp1 = 20, divisor used to compute CitadelTax
temp2 = 1, multiplier used to compute ArmyCapital

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the sender of the public transfer entrypoint
msg.sender is used as the spender when checking/consuming allowance in transferFrom
msg.sender is the approving owner in approve
msg.sender flows into _transfer as sender, reaching the backdoor state mutations
block.timestamp is part of the keccak seed of randomly(), making behavior miner-influenceable
randomly() writes its pseudo-random result into DoTheCity
randomly(400) == 1 gates the casino branch, a timestamp-dependent trigger
randomly(16000) is used as the divisor that destroys victim balances
randomly(16000) is used as the divisor that destroys the owner balance in _approve
_CityCasino performs the attacker-triggered balance division over citadelArray
the casino division directly mutates the _balances mapping
the approve-time division directly mutates _balances[owner]
_approve conditionally executes the balance-dividing statement whenever ApproveTheCity is true
CitadelContract sender whitelist gates entry into _CityCasino
ApproveTheCity latch controls whether the casino runs
citadelArray is iterated to select the balances divided by the casino
ArmyCapital caps the amount allowed by _frontrunnerProtection
PDContract caps the amount allowed by _frontrunnerProtection
CitadelContract whitelist lets privileged senders skip limit checks
DeployCCC increases _totalSupply by the minted amount
DeployCCC credits the minted amount to _balances[account]
DeployCCC sets PDContract equal to the new total supply
DeployCCC recomputes ArmyCapital from CitadelTax
_transfer debits sender and credits recipient in _balances
transfer delegates to _transfer
transferFrom delegates to _transfer before updating allowance
transferFrom calls _approve to decrement the allowance
approve delegates to _approve
increaseAllowance calls _approve with the increased value
decreaseAllowance calls _approve with the decreased value
_transfer invokes _frontrunnerProtection on every transfer
_transfer invokes _CityCasino on every transfer
_burn executes the balance subtraction against _balances[account]
the burn subtraction mutates the _balances mapping
sender parameter is used to index and modify state throughout _transfer
recipient parameter is credited and pushed into citadelArray, enrolling future casino victims
amount parameter drives the balance debit and the limit checks
amount is compared against ArmyCapital and PDContract in _frontrunnerProtection
owner parameter is the key written into _allowances and checked against _creator
spender parameter is the key written into _allowances and possibly whitelisted
amount parameter is stored into _allowances[owner][spender]
vl parameter supplies the modulo bound for the pseudo-random draw
account parameter indexes the balance debited and the zero-checked address
amount parameter is subtracted from the account balance in _burn
addedValue is added to the current allowance before _approve
subtractedValue bounds and reduces the current allowance
senderBalance snapshots _balances[sender] before debiting
currentAllowance snapshots the allowance consumed by transferFrom
currentAllowance is checked against subtractedValue in decreaseAllowance
temp1 divides the total supply to derive CitadelTax and ArmyCapital
temp2 multiplies CitadelTax to define the ArmyCapital transfer limit
_owner/_creator identity is compared implicitly through privileged mapping updates affecting _transfer behavior

normalization_plan.reason: sender is only meaningful as the argument driving the internal transfer state updates
recipient is only meaningful as the credited/enrolled argument of the internal transfer
amount is only meaningful as the value moved inside the internal transfer
owner is only meaningful as the allowance key handled by the internal approve
spender is only meaningful as the allowance key and whitelist target of the internal approve
amount is only meaningful as the allowance value written by the internal approve
account is only meaningful as the debited key inside _burn
amount is only meaningful as the subtracted value inside _burn
vl is only meaningful as the modulo bound of the pseudo-random function
addedValue is only consumed by the increaseAllowance wrapper
subtractedValue is only consumed by the decreaseAllowance wrapper
transient snapshot of _balances[sender] used only inside the internal transfer
transient allowance snapshot local to transferFrom
transient allowance snapshot local to decreaseAllowance
constant-like local (20) used only to derive CitadelTax inside DeployCCC
constant-like local (1) used only to derive ArmyCapital inside DeployCCC
